name: team_pressure_a_car_far_out_of_range_is_charged_less_as_it_closes
description: 1v1: blue starts 4500 uu from the ball and rolls at 1000 uu/s (throttle on) toward it. Its projected distance is d - 2 s x min(speed, 1000): 2500 at the start (charge 0.5) and falling by about 67 uu a step as it closes (the charge is the smoothstep of (d_eff - 2000) / 1000), so the charge fades from -0.5 to 0 over the first 7-8 steps instead of the old flat -1 until it crossed 4000 uu (old total -6). Expectation: a total between -3.5 and -1.0, and exactly 0 over the last 15 steps.

expect.intent: charged only until the projected distance reaches 2000 uu
